description: The most fundamental component for building UI layouts. Acts as a container supporting flexbox layout, styling, touch handling, and accessibility.

data.name: accessible
data.description: Marks the view as accessible to assistive technologies.

data.name: accessibilityLabel
data.description: Overrides the text read by screen readers.

data.name: accessibilityHint
data.description: Explains what will happen when the user interacts.

data.name: accessibilityRole
data.description: Defines the role of the component for accessibility.

data.name: accessibilityState
data.description: Describes the current state like disabled or selected.

data.name: onStartShouldSetResponder
data.description: Decides if the view should respond to touch start.

data.name: onResponderMove
data.description: Called when the user moves their finger.

data.name: onResponderRelease
data.description: Called when the touch is released.

data.name: hitSlop
data.description: Expands the touchable area of the view.

data.name: pointerEvents
data.description: Controls whether the view receives touch events.

data.name: collapsable
data.description: Allows layout-only views to be removed for performance.

data.name: removeClippedSubviews
data.description: Improves performance by clipping offscreen views.

example.title: Basic View Example
example.description: A simple layout with two colored boxes and text inside a row.

code.snippet:
<View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', padding: 16 }}>
  <View style={{ width: 50, height: 50, backgroundColor: 'red' }} />
  <View style={{ width: 50, height: 50, backgroundColor: 'blue', marginLeft: 10 }} />
  <Text style={{ marginLeft: 10 }}>Hello View</Text>
</View>
